text: Explorers Charm was found!
I see you have awakened...
Ugh.. Where I am? Who are you?

I am known as Kappa, an imp who lives
in the mountains to the northeast.
Alright, imp....
What the hell is that?

Those would be the Imperial Magitek armor 
units that have been attacking the 
Returners hiding out nearby.

Foolish Returners! Ha! They have no hope 
of defeating the Empire. What a lost cause.

I watched your battle against those who 
seem to be allied with the Returners, yet 
you also appear to have no love for the 
Empire.
Yeah? And what of it?

Tell me, warrior, where does your 
allegiance lie?

I bow to no one and pledge myself only
to my own pride—a pride that was recently
damaged and must be avenged!

We imps have long been outcasts in this
world, taking no sides but our own 
survival. Tell me your name, warrior.

I am Vargas, and I thank you for your 
assistance. I am in your debt—something 
that must be repaid. So tell me, Kappa, 
how may I repay this debt to you?
You need protection?

Yes, and upon reaching my tribe, I can 
reward you with some items we have 
recovered.

Alright, that sounds like a deal. Just 
try not to get in my way and stay alive.

Thank you, and don't worry. Though we imps
lack any special abilities, we can become 
strong fighters.

Let us be off; we have a lot of ground 
to cover.

South out of this cave, then northeast is 
the Returners' hideout—or what's left of 
it, I suppose. That's where Sabin was 
headed, so I need to go there!

Further north is a Rhinox cave. We imps 
have had many conflicts with them, and we 
might find some items inside if we 
venture in.

Ah yes, we may consider that, as long as
it doesn't take too long!

I must tell you, Kappa, I fully intend to 
track down my rival, Sabin, and defeat 
him once and for all.

I assumed as much. I will do what I can 
to aid you in this.

I do not care for the wars of others and
will crush whoever stands in my way!
Understood, Master Vargas.

I know Sabin went to the Returners' 
hideout, and as long as the Empire hasn't 
completely slaughtered them, maybe we can 
find a Returner still alive...

Alive enough to beat the information 
out of him! Ha ha ha!

...Ah, um, yes, we will do what we must. 
But first, we need to head south to exit 
this cave, then go north to the Returners' 
hideout. It connects to a river!

If we exit this cave to the north and go 
back into Mt. Kolts, who knows what we may 
find... The choice is yours, Master Vargas.

I have something useful back at my father 
Duncan's place. If we go back through the 
mountains, we should stop there.
